title: Substrates Materials Engineering Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Supports engineers to define material inspection methodology, conducts studies related to cost control, process control, and production yield, and implements plans and programs to optimize supply chain.
Supports engineers in establishing supplier process window validation activities on critical process modules for technology development.
Performs basic root cause analysis to find opportunities for process and quality & reliability improvements and collaborates with engineers to implement solutions.
Conducts lab experiment to characterize new materials; analyze and compares multiple candidate’s properties and recommends the best candidates.
Supports engineering in exploring and benchmarking emerging technology in the industry. Contributes to Intel's future technology definition and requirements. Highlights gaps between roadmap strategy, manufacturing capability, and market demand and recommends solutions to addresses those gaps.
Performs data analysis for problem-solving, process development and related purposes.
Qualifications:
Current pursuing BS, MS or PhD in Chemical/Material/Polymer/Material engineering fields or in Chemistry/Physics/Material Science .
Fluent communication and articulation skills in English, good presentation skills, and ability to effectively communicate with engineers around the world.
Good problem solving, data analytics and statistical knowledge.
Independent, strong will to learn and innovate and take on challenging assignments.
Job Type:
Student / Intern
Shift:
Shift 1 (Malaysia)
Primary Location:
Malaysia, Penang
Additional Locations:
